entries.007338eb0529f6e8: This is the sole reportable segment of the company group. In addition to manufacturing and selling building materials, including extrusion-molded cement products, the company undertakes contracting, design, and supervision of construction works using its products. Sales are handled by the company and consolidated subsidiary Nozawa Shōji Co., Ltd., and the latter supplies part of the auxiliary materials used by the company. The company and Nozawa Shōji Co., Ltd. also design and carry out construction works. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,312 million, of which revenue from extrusion-molded cement products was ¥17,492 million and other revenue was ¥4,820 million, by product and service.
entries.05b3d038cf336535: A building materials manufacturer founded in 1897 and headquartered in Kobe. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 2 consolidated subsidiaries and 332 consolidated employees.
entries.0673d210b9a1ef7d: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥605 million.
entries.06f7fadd686a043b: The company has formulated the medium-term management plan “NOZAWA NEXT3” and will pursue it through 3 categories: “KOKOROZASHI-Vision” (aspiration), “MINORI-Profit” (substance) and “ISHIZUE-Base” (foundation). Under “MINORI” (substance), the company will expand the product lineup of the ASLOCK exterior wall material for general construction from lower-priced to higher-priced ranges, promote sales expansion of “ASLOCK factory-painted products” and adoption of “factory pre-processing”, and, as a new business, it will develop “Mirufia”, an on-site painting method with multi-color finishes for ASLOCK, and open up the market through the painting works business of its subsidiary Nozawa Shoji Co., Ltd. Under “ISHIZUE” (foundation), it will work on AI utilization and DX promotion, and on securing and developing human resources and reforming its personnel system.
